projects.name: User Authentication System
projects.description: Complete authentication system with JWT tokens, OAuth2 integration, and role-based access control (RBAC). Supports multiple authentication providers and secure session management.

issues.description:
Complete authentication system with JWT tokens, OAuth2 integration, and role-based access control (RBAC). Supports multiple authentication providers and secure session management.

*Business Value*
Enables secure user access, protects sensitive data, and provides foundation for all user-facing features. Critical for launch.

*Acceptance Criteria*
1. Users can register with email/password
2. Users can login with JWT tokens
3. OAuth2 integration with Google and GitHub
4. Role-based permissions working correctly
5. Session management with refresh tokens

Implement JWT-based authentication with access and refresh tokens

*Technical Approach*
Use jsonwebtoken library, Redis for token blacklist, HTTP-only cookies for security

issues.summary: As a user, I want to login with email and password so that I can access my account securely
issues.description:
Implement login endpoint with credential validation and JWT token generation

*Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)*

1. *Given:* I have valid credentials
   *When:* I submit login form
   *Then:* I receive JWT access and refresh tokens

2. *Given:* I have invalid credentials
   *When:* I submit login form
   *Then:* I receive 401 error with descriptive message
Generate access token (15min) and refresh token (7 days)
Test success, invalid credentials, missing fields, SQL injection

issues.summary: As a user, I want my session to persist so that I do not need to login frequently
issues.description:
Implement refresh token rotation for long-lived sessions

*Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)*

1. *Given:* My access token expires
   *When:* I use my refresh token
   *Then:* I receive new access and refresh tokens

Integrate OAuth2 providers for social login (Google, GitHub)

*Technical Approach*
Use Passport.js OAuth2 strategies, link social accounts to users

*Dependencies*
feature-jwt

Implement RBAC with roles (admin, user, guest) and permissions

*Technical Approach*
Middleware for route protection, role hierarchy in database

*Dependencies*
feature-jwt
